title: How Long Does a Settlement Take in Columbia?
metaDescription: How long car accident settlements take in Columbia: Missouri timelines, medical liens, and negotiation phases.
excerpt: Educational Columbia, MO guide — 5-year SOL, local hospitals, and insurer tactics. Not legal advice.

sections.heading: Missouri deadline overview
paragraphs: Most Missouri car accident injury lawsuits must be filed within **5 years** of the injury date. Missing this deadline can permanently bar recovery.
Wrongful death, government-entity, and minor claimant cases may follow different rules. This article is educational — confirm your dates with a licensed Missouri attorney.

sections.heading: Why waiting hurts Columbia claims
paragraphs: With ~thousands of annual crashes in the Columbia area, evidence fades fast: skid marks wash away, witnesses relocate, and video is overwritten.
Insurers begin building a file immediately. Early recorded statements can lock in descriptions before you know the full extent of injuries.

sections.heading: Comparative fault in Missouri
paragraphs: Missouri follows Pure comparative rules. If you are found partially at fault, compensation may be reduced or barred depending on your percentage.
Document everything that supports the other driver's negligence — traffic citations, 911 calls, and witness statements.

sections.heading: Insurance minimums and coverage gaps
paragraphs: Missouri requires at least 25/50/25 in liability coverage (verify current law). Many at-fault drivers carry only minimums.
Review your declarations page for UM/UIM, MedPay, and PIP. These coverages can matter when the other driver is uninsured or underinsured in Columbia.

sections.heading: Government and special entities
paragraphs: Claims involving city buses, state vehicles, or federal property often require earlier notice than the standard 5-year window. Missing a notice deadline can defeat an otherwise valid claim.

sections.heading: Practical timeline for Columbia residents
paragraphs: Day 1–7: Medical care, police report, insurer notification (facts only).
Week 2–8: Follow treatment plans, gather bills, avoid social media posts about the crash.
Month 2+: If injuries continue, consult counsel before accepting settlement releases.

faq.question: Is this legal advice for my Columbia case?
faq.answer: No. This is general education from WreckMatch LLC, a referral service — not a law firm. Consult a licensed attorney for advice about your situation.

faq.question: What is the statute of limitations in Missouri?
faq.answer: Most injury claims face a 5-year deadline, but exceptions apply. Verify your dates with counsel.
